name: LAMM
description: An open-source language-assisted multi-modal instruction tuning dataset, framework, and benchmark designed to train and evaluate multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) across a wide range of 2D and 3D vision tasks, facilitating human-AI interaction beyond text.
reputation: A notable open-source multimodal instruction-tuning dataset and benchmark used in MLLM research, especially for combining 2D and 3D vision-language tasks.
notes: Includes a training framework and baseline models; supports rapid scaling and extension to diverse domains and modalities.
